description: Security testing processes are not defined and implemented in the development lifecycle. This signal indicates that applications and systems are developed and deployed without appropriate security testing such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, penetration testing, or vulnerability scanning.
applicability: Applicable to all software development and system deployment activities including application development, infrastructure deployment, configuration changes, and system updates. Covers security testing in development, testing, staging, and pre-production environments.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of testing procedures, CI/CD pipeline configurations, security testing tool deployment, test reports and results, acceptance criteria, and development workflow documentation. May also be identified through absence of security testing tools or security test cases.
